nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: There! Some daisies like in the photo...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And there's a creek with mossy stones...
She bursts out into the parking area with Wes at her side!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Are you okay? Those were some pretty rough spills back there.
Autumn blushes, embarrassed, and tries to ignore her aching ankle.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm okay. Just a little clumsy, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Any sign of Lindsay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... Do you see her?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No... But I think she's been here.
Autumn follows Wes' gaze... To the deflated tires of his car!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no... She did `not` do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no... She did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] do that!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, they didn't deflate themselves.
Just then, there's the roar of an engine! Wes and Autumn spin around to see Lindsay's sports car come flying out of a cluster of trees and race off down the road!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Toodles, losers!
She vanishes down the dirt path in a cloud of exhaust.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Unbelievable. Even for her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That... That selfish... Manipulative... Snotty... Little--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Let's save the expletives for later. Right now, we need to focus on getting you back to campus.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If we don't get to Nikolai with the proof before he makes his decision, it'll be too late.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Wes, she just deflated the tires on your car. How can you still be so focused on me?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Believe me, this isn't the first time someone's done a number on that old hunk of a junk. I'll be fine. You're the one who's got a great internship on the line.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So what do we do now? My phone's got no service out here.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Only one thing we `can` do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Only one thing we [color=#e23b3b][i]can[/i][/color] do.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We walk.
Autumn has failed.

nodes.text: Autumn jumps for no reason, and twists her ankle on landing!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ow!
Autumn pulls herself up, embarrassed...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So clumsy...
Autumn ducks for no reason, trips over her own feet, and sprawls out on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ow!
Autumn pulls herself up, embarrassed...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So clumsy...
Autumn just stays focused on sprinting!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hffff!
Autumn rounds some trees. She can see a clear, dirt path to the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Almost there!
Autumn jumps, flying right into the branch! It catches her on the chin, and she falls onto her back in the dirt!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `Aghhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aghhh![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just as Wes catches up, Autumn scrambles to her feet and keeps running!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Come on, come on...
Autumn ducks her head low, going right under the branch!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Too close!
In front of her, the forest is thinning! Autumn narrows her gaze and keeps sprinting...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I need to... To... Uh...
Autumn's too slow! She slams into the branch with her forehead and falls back into the dirt!
In front of her is a thick, gnarled, low-hanging branch!
Autumn ducks low, ineffectually, and slams into the log with her shins!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Autumn falls over the log, flopping into the dirt!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm fine!
Autumn picks herself and keeps running!
Autumn jumps, neatly clearing the log in one stride!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ufff!
She lands and keeps running!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...
Autumn hesitates and slams into the log with her shins!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Do you have any proof?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Well, you could just go to my website... I put duplicates of all my photos up there...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Excellent.

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: But you know, she was just here a few minutes ago, actually.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wait... She was here? Just now?!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Well, yeah, she dropped by to pay me in cash and headed back out to the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: She `did` say something about having to go fast because of some snoops following her... That wouldn't be you, would it?
nodes.text_bbcode: She [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] say something about having to go fast because of some snoops following her... That wouldn't be you, would it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: We can confront her, here and now!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Let's move!
Wes and Autumn turn and sprint off, rushing back into the woods!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Wait! Where are you going? What's all this about?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Would you like to buy some photos?
Autumn and Wes sprint through the forest as fast as they can, retracing their footsteps back to the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Come on, come on...
Autumn rounds a corner and sees a heavy log lying across the path!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Uh... You sure about that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sure, why not? I think it could be funny!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, uh, okay... If you say so... But I should warn you, I can be very convincing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, is that a dare? Because you're on!
Autumn grabs Wes' hand and pulls him out of the bushes, walking towards the photographer!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, look, sweetie! Isn't this just the cutest little grove?
Wes hesitates for one second, then sidles up to Autumn, wrapping his arm around her waist.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, it's just gorgeous, baby... But not as gorgeous as you!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Tee hee! Aren't you the sweetest?
The photographer turns around, noticing them...

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Oh, hello there! Having a nice stroll through the woods?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yep! We're just a sweet young couple, basking in each other's love, taking in the wonders of nature!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wow, we're really laying it on thick, aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know it, sweetie!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Well, aren't you two just adorable? It's always so heart-warming to see a young couple in love!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Would you mind if I took a photo of you two?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of course! Go right ahead!
Autumn and Wes pose, hugging, gently pressing together cheek-to-cheek...

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Oh, perfect! Just wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It must be pretty lonely out here... We're probably the first people you saw all day, huh?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Usually, yes, but today's been a quite a day! There was that young girl who called me up earlier...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Oh really?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Why, yes, it was the craziest thing! She was in quite a tizzy!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: I guess she'd looked up local photographers online, and found me... And needed me to email her every photo I took this morning!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh she did, did she?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Yep. I thought it was odd, but she offered to pay me very generously. Kids these days, I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Classic kids.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You sure you want to do that?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Why not? It'll be like a cop movie! We'll intimidate him so he's all rattled, and then make him fess up about Lindsay!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can be the good cop, and I'll be the bad cop! That `always` works!
nodes.text_bbcode: You can be the good cop, and I'll be the bad cop! That [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] works!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It wouldn't be my first pick... But hey, if that's what you want, okay, we can do it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Trust me, Wes. I've got this.
Autumn steps out from the bushes, Wes at her side.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hey! You!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, you, bub! We need a word!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Who exactly are you?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm Ranger McKnuckles, and this is my partner, Ranger McScruffy!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Yes. That's me. Ranger... Ranger McScruffy.

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Is that Polish?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Drop the chit-chat, snip-snap! We're tough cops, and we don't take any guff!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: I'm sorry, I'm totally confused.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Please, sir, just cooperate. My partner here, she's a real loose cannon...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's right! I'm crazy and unpredictable, so you better start answering questions fast!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What're you even doing out here, huh?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Taking pictures...?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Convenient. `Real` convenient.
nodes.text_bbcode: Convenient. [color=#3b78e2][i]Real[/i][/color] convenient.

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Well, it's a beautiful clearing, and the lighting is just stellar, so I--

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Don't you mess with me, bub! I play by my own rules! My personal life's a mess! My ex-wife's moving to New York, and she's taking the kids!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Look, what exactly is going on here? Is this some kind of reality TV prank show?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Is someone about to hit me with a water balloon full of bees?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You saw that show too?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, I'm just going to jump in here. Sir, we're not really... Whatever she was just pretending we were. We're just two kids looking for some help.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Did anyone talk to you today about your photos? A girl our age, maybe?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Why, yes, it was the craziest thing! This young girl called me up earlier, and she was in quite a tizzy!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: I guess she'd looked up local photographers online, and found me... And needed me to email her every photo I took this morning!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh she did, did she?

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Yep. I thought it was odd, but she offered to pay me very generously. I thought it was kind of shady...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh, you have no idea.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: We're totally lost, aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's looking that way, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe we should head back to the car...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, see, the funny thing about being lost is...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You don't know how to get back to the car.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That'd be it, yeah.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no. This is not good.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's okay. Don't panic. We'll just try to carefully retrace our footsteps. How difficult could that be?
Ten hours later...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Surprisingly difficult!
Autumn and Wes trudge through the undergrowth. They're covered in dirt, their clothes ripped, their hair disheveled...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ugh, Wes, I'm not feeling great... I think it might've been those berries I ate earlier...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You think those were bad berries?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, let me put it this way. Did `you` just see a chocolate walrus fly by on a chariot made of music?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, let me put it this way. Did [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] just see a chocolate walrus fly by on a chariot made of music?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Really, really bad berries.
Wes takes Autumn's hand and leads her forward...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Just stick close to me, okay? We'll find somewhere to hunker down for the night.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh, Wes. You're such a nice guy. Your hands feel like friendship. Sweaty, sweaty friendship.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Thanks...?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm sorry I got you mixed up in all this. You shouldn't even be out here.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No. Don't apologize. This is all my fault. I'm the reason all this happened.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I mean...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey! Look! Lights! I can see lights in the distance! Let's head towards them!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wait, which lights? The flickering campfire lights over the hill, or the dancing orbs of twilight having a tickle fight in the sky?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Just follow me.
Wes leads Autumn by the hand through the woods before coming onto a campsite!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: There, see? We're out of the woods! Things are finally working out!
Just then, the tents open up... And the Twin Branches cheerleaders spill out!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I've got to stop saying things like that.
The girls cluster around the incredibly disheveled Autumn and Wes, pointing and gawking...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What `happened` to you two?
nodes.text_bbcode: What [color=#3b78e2][i]happened[/i][/color] to you two?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You look like you've been out here for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Gasp! Are you secretly werewolves? How often do you transform? Are you cute wolves or scary wolves? Do you ever turn into wolves and `then` make out?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Gasp! Are you secretly werewolves? How often do you transform? Are you cute wolves or scary wolves? Do you ever turn into wolves and [color=#3b78e2][i]then[/i][/color] make out?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: The people have a right to know!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No... We're not werewolves. We just got lost this afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, their faces are wobbling. Can you make their faces stop wobbling?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Also, Autumn ate some bad berries.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What are you lot doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We always go camping on my birthday. It's not for a couple days, but we had to move it up because Lindsay's going to be gone all summer.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh no.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She just got this fancy internship...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: The Nikolai Tyrell Photographers of the Future Internship, in fact!
Lindsay strolls over, a camera slung over her shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: While you two were off playing Pocahontas in the trees, `I` was busy winning, `just` like I said I would!
nodes.text_bbcode: While you two were off playing Pocahontas in the trees, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was busy winning, [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] like I said I would!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I guess I'm just that much more serious about photography!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: She's saying words, but they're not true... I don't like it...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: And I have to say, I think I just found the subjects of my first photo series!
Lindsay whips up her camera and starts snapping pictures of Wes and Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I call it Woodland Freaks!
Wes looks down, beaten.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well... This is pretty much a total disaster.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's okay, Wes. Don't feel sad. This isn't real. It's just a hallucination caused by the berries!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `Isn't it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Isn't it?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: There's no question about it...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm... Like a frog...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What about that one over there? That's kind of froggish...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's it! Good eye!
Wes and Autumn rush over to the rock, descending into a beautiful forest clearing...
Where a middle-aged man is busily snapping nature photos!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Oh yeah... That's perfect... The way the light falls on the leaves, mmm! `Mmm!` Just wonderful!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah... That's perfect... The way the light falls on the leaves, mmm! [color=#e23b3b][i]Mmm![/i][/color] Just wonderful!

nodes.text: Autumn and Wes huddle up, hidden behind some bushes. They talk in urgent whispers...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, we need to find out if he helped Lindsay, right? But if we ask him directly, he might deny it...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Right! So let's do one of your famous cons!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: My what?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know! Your plots or schemes or double dupes!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, I have `never` done a double dupe...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] done a double dupe...

nodes.text: Autumn playfully punches Wes in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know what I mean, jerk!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, okay, we'll do a con. What'd you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmm... Let's pretend to be...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm... I guess that one down the hill looks kind of like a dog...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A misshapen, gawky, one-eared dog...
Autumn and Wes descend down a steep hill, finding themselves surrounded by a thick cluster of trees...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wrong rock?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't want to say 'yes', but... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A rock shaped like a log?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, you know, all brown and long and wooden...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Maybe I'm just thinking of a log.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, well, there's a log just down that hill.
Autumn and Wes descend down a steep hill, finding themselves surrounded by a thick cluster of trees...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wrong rock?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't want to say 'yes', but... Yes.

nodes.text: A misshapen, gawky, one-eared hog...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wrong rock?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't want to say 'yes', but... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Like a... A... Uh... You know, a...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Like a rock?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A rock shaped like a rock?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah... All gray and rocky...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Uh... Well, there's a big rock at the bottom of that hill...
Autumn and Wes descend down a steep hill, finding themselves surrounded by a thick cluster of trees...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wrong rock?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't want to say 'yes', but... Yes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Uh... There! I think we should go there!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I think so... I mean, it's got stones... And flowers... And a tree?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We're in a forest, Autumn. Those things are everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh. Good point.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Good, good! We're getting closer!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Now we just need to find a rock shaped like a...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We're here.
Wes pulls over into a small parking lot in front of an old sign saying 'Georgette Woods'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So what now?
Wes hops a railing and sets off, tromping into the woods.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We go right to the source.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How do we know where to go?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Just keep your eyes open! Look for anything from the photos. And stay close... No cell service out here.
Autumn looks around, and makes her way towards...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Not sure I follow.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're just... You're always so guarded, so defensive. You don't ever tell anyone anything personal. You never let anyone in.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I mean, we're friends, right? But I don't really know anything about you. I don't know what you do on weekends. I don't know where you grew up. I don't even know what kind of food you like!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And is that so important to you? Knowing all the details of my life? Does it `really` matter if you know whether I like to wake up with a bowl of Fruit Wheels or Cocoa Balls?
nodes.text_bbcode: And is that so important to you? Knowing all the details of my life? Does it [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] matter if you know whether I like to wake up with a bowl of Fruit Wheels or Cocoa Balls?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well... Not that specifically... But I just don't want you to feel like you have to hold back.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: If you want to open up to me, Wes, you can.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But that's the thing, Autumn. I `don't` want to open up.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's the thing, Autumn. I [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] want to open up.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And believe me, you don't want me to either.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...You're right. I'm sorry I pried. I'll... I'll respect your boundaries.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's okay. Don't worry about it. I know I'm not the easiest guy to be friends with.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I mean, we're friends, right? But I don't really know anything about you. I don't know what you do on weekends. I don't know where you grew up. I don't even know what kind of food you like!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Everything about you is a secret!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, well, everyone's got secrets.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's not true! I don't!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Really? Then tell me about your first kiss.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What? That... That's personal!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Which is another word for 'secret'. I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I... But that's... I...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Sigh.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I've... Never actually kissed anyone.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wait, what? Really?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Really. It's not that I haven't wanted to. It's just... There was always something in the way. Some reason it didn't work out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I've never actually had a first kiss. There. It's out in the open. Not a secret anymore.
Wes stares at Autumn, head cocked to the side with curiosity, and then smiles.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Microwave burritos.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's my favorite food. Microwave burritos. I've eaten prime cut steaks, exotic curries, and all other expensive stuff, but there's nothing I like more than a nice, blazing hot, chunky, gooey, microwave burrito.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Congratulations. Now you know something about me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah. I do.
A little while later, Wes drives along the highway, down towards Georgette Woods. Autumn sits in the passenger seat...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Thanks for helping me out with this, Wes. I'm sure this isn't how you planned on spending your day...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Helping a friend out, getting some fresh air, and exposing Lindsay as a fraud? What could be better?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't know... Taking it easy and enjoying your summer break?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that `would` be better. Still, this isn't bad!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, that [color=#e23b3b][i]would[/i][/color] be better. Still, this isn't bad!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hold on, gonna take a shortcut here. It's faster to take the back roads, but they can be a little bumpy.
Wes makes a left, turning into a dark, wooded stretch...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Do you come here often?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Not really, no.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But you know your way around?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's a long story. Not that interesting. Don't worry about it.
Autumn stares at Wes curiously.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...What is it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's just...

options.label: You can open up to me.
You must have some serious secrets.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What about them?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They're... Pretty?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, they're okay, but how does that help us? There are daisies everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I know, I know. I just like them...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Duly noted, but there's got to be something in the photos that's less common than daisies... Something recognizable and distinctive...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Like redwoods!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Redwood trees! The only place even remotely nearby that has redwoods is Georgette Woods!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Then that sounds like our best lead! Let's roll.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What about them?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: They're... You know. Stones. And they've got moss on them. Mossy stones.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah... And?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: And... This is the part where you say 'Oh! I know those stones! And I know just where to find them!'

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...But I don't.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah. I figured that out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Look, there's got to be something in the photos that's less common than mossy stones... Something recognizable and distinctive...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Like redwoods!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Redwood trees! The only place even remotely nearby that has redwoods is Georgette Woods!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Then that sounds like our best lead! Let's roll.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The redwood trees! Those aren't common at all!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Huh... You're right.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: In fact, the only place remotely nearby that has redwoods is Georgette Woods!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, look at that. You're good. Maybe I should hire you next time I need a private eye to track down someone who stiffed me.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Is that a joke?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah. Sure. Let's say it's a joke.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Now come on! Let's roll. Georgette Woods is our best lead.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: On the contrary. There's plenty to do.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Lindsay's photo series was good. `Too` good. Way too good.
nodes.text_bbcode: Lindsay's photo series was good. [color=#e23b3b][i]Too[/i][/color] good. Way too good.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm saying she cheated. Those weren't her photos. I'm betting she didn't even use her camera.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's low, even for Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Actually... No... It's exactly on her level.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. And we're not going to let her get away with it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We'll find proof she cheated, and fast. If we can get it to Nikolai before he leaves today, we've got a good shot.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That makes sense... But where are we going to find this proof?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I don't quite know... But I figure her photos are a good start.
Wes reaches into his jacket and pulls out three glossy nature photos. He tosses them onto the table.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What the... Are these Lindsay's photos?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yup. I stole them off Nikolai's desk while he was off taking a meditation break.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Relax, it's just three pictures out of 50. He won't notice they're gone.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Here's where I need your help, though. I'm thinking there's something in these pictures that'll give us a clue as to how Lindsay got them.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But I have no idea what that is.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Why don't you take a look at them and tell me if anything pops out?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmm... Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The timestamp in the corner looks legit. These photos `were` taken today. Which probably rules out the possibility of her buying them online.
nodes.text_bbcode: The timestamp in the corner looks legit. These photos [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] taken today. Which probably rules out the possibility of her buying them online.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Could she have hired someone to take them for her?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That would make sense...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm... If we could get to the place the photos were taken, we `might` be able to find some evidence. Any idea where these woods are?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmmm... If we could get to the place the photos were taken, we [color=#e23b3b][i]might[/i][/color] be able to find some evidence. Any idea where these woods are?

nodes.text: Autumn holds up the photos and looks at them closely.
The photos depict a beautiful clearing in the woods. You can see clusters of perfect yellow `daisies...`
nodes.text_bbcode: The photos depict a beautiful clearing in the woods. You can see clusters of perfect yellow [b]daisies...[/b]

nodes.text: A lush `creek` full of `mossy stones...`
nodes.text_bbcode: A lush [b]creek[/b] full of [b]mossy stones...[/b]

nodes.text: And a `frog-shaped rock,` resting under some tall `redwoods.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And a [b]frog-shaped rock,[/b] resting under some tall [b]redwoods.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well? See anything that might help us pin down where these photos were taken?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmm... I think our best clue is the...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That makes two of us. And that's why it's not going to happen.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No matter what Nikolai decides, no matter how this goes, Lindsay's not going to get away with treating people like crap. I'll make sure of it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: One way or another... Lindsay'll pay.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Thanks, Wes. I appreciate that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just remind me to never get on your bad side.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You never could.
Autumn reaches over and pats Wes' hand. He flinches, for just a second, but then smiles.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I guess there's nothing to do but wait.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `No.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do you mean 'no'?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I mean no, I'm not going to let you talk like that.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No matter how today goes, no matter what Nikolai picks, no matter what Lindsay does, you are `not` a failure, and you never will be.
nodes.text_bbcode: No matter how today goes, no matter what Nikolai picks, no matter what Lindsay does, you are [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] a failure, and you never will be.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No, I mean it. The one thing I can't stand is quitter talk. If you're going to call yourself a failure, then I'm just going to walk.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Okay. Okay. I'm `not` a failure.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Okay. Okay. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a failure.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But there's still nothing I can do.
And now...

nodes.text: Wes slows down, just a little...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Please, Wes... You can't go. I need you too much.
Wes hesitates, then sighs and stops the truck. Autumn runs over, just as he gets out.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What is it? What did Lindsay do? What do you need my help with?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No, it's not that. I don't need your help, Wes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I need `you.` In my life.
nodes.text_bbcode: I need [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color] In my life.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Autumn, you said it right the first time. I'm manipulative. I'm a creep. I'm nothing but trouble.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. When I said that, I... I didn't understand. But now I do.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I might not know all the details, but I can tell your life's been so hard, so unpredictable, so unstable...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: The way you gather secrets, make plans, hatch schemes... You don't do it because you want power. You do it because you feel `powerless.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The way you gather secrets, make plans, hatch schemes... You don't do it because you want power. You do it because you feel [color=#3b78e2][i]powerless.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You do it because it's the only way you know how to feel safe.
Wes turns away. His eyes betray the truth.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Maybe so... But it doesn't change anything. All I'll do is bring you down.
Autumn reaches forward and gently touches Wes' cheek...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No, Wes, you won't...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Because there are other ways to feel safe.
Wes tries to say something, and then Autumn leans forward and kisses him.
He startles for one moment, then wraps his arm around her and kisses her back.
It's Autumn's first kiss... Tender, sweet, and passionate. It's everything she could have wanted, and it goes on for what feels like forever...
Then Wes pulls away, smiling.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...You should get back in there. Nikolai's probably waiting.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Will I see you later?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Count on it.
Autumn turns to head back to the gym. She glances over her shoulder as she goes...
And sees Wes, smiling and waiting for her.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I won the internship, Wes! I did it! It's mine!
Wes slows down. He smiles, just a little, talking softly to himself...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Good for you, Autumn...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Enjoy it.
Then he steps on the gas and drives off.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No!
It's too late. Wes vanishes out the school gate and down the road towards the highway.
Watching him go, Autumn knows, in her heart, that she'll never see him again. She knows...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I lost, Wes! I didn't get it!
Wes slows down, frowning...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...I'm sorry I ever got your hopes up.
Then he steps on the gas and drives off.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No!
It's too late. Wes vanishes out the school gate and down the road towards the highway.
Watching him go, Autumn knows, in her heart, that she'll never see him again. She knows...
Autumn hesitates, choking, unable to find the words.
With a sigh, Wes steps on the gas and drives off.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No!
It's too late. Wes vanishes out the school gate and down the road towards the highway.
Watching him go, Autumn knows, in her heart, that she'll never see him again. She knows...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Just go. Seriously.
Autumn tries to find something to say, but can't. The look on Wes' face is just too sad, too broken, too hurt.
Fighting back tears, she gets out of the car and rushes forward, into the gym...
Where Nikolai Tyrell is standing on the stage!

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: After great deliberation, I have finally come to a decision regarding the winner of the next Tyrell Studios Internship!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm too late!
Lindsay sits in front of him, and glances back at Autumn with a smug grin!
Autumn's heart stops in her chest. Nikolai strides forward.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: And my next intern will be...

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Autumn Brooks!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Yeah, what?

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Her work had masterful technique... Beautiful composition... And a true artist's understanding of subject and mood.
Lindsay lunges up, striding towards the stage...

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, there must be some mistake. My photos were good. Like, really, `really` good...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah, there must be some mistake. My photos were good. Like, really, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] good...

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: They were high-quality, yes. Elegantly staged and shot.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: But they were also tired, soulless, and worst of all, generic. I saw nothing of you in them. No hint of your personality or individuality or soul.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: If I didn't know better, I'd suspect you just bought a batch of stock, professional images and passed them off as your own!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: I... Well... Whaaaaaaat?

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: You've wasted enough of my time today, young lady.
Nikolai steps past Lindsay and turns to Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Autumn Brooks, I would like to offer you the position of my intern. Would you take it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of... Of course!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Hmph! This stupid thing was rigged to begin with!
Lindsay turns around and storms off. Nikolai watches her go, shaking his head.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Tyrell, sir, this is `such` a honor...
nodes.text_bbcode: Mr. Tyrell, sir, this is [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] a honor...

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: The honor is mine. One of the greatest joys of being a veteran artist is the chance to discover new talent... And yours is truly astounding.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: This is so amazing... It's like a dream come true. And I couldn't have done it without...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Without...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Without the person who set it all up... The person who got Nikolai here in the first place... The person who always had my back.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Mr. Tyrell, sir... Can I have one quick minute? There's someone I need to tell about this.

nodes.speaker: Nikolai Tyrell
nodes.text: Of course, my dear. I'll be here.
Autumn turns and runs out of the gym, back towards the parking lot.
Autumn looks around frantically and sees Wes in his truck, pulling away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `Wes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wes![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He shakes his head. He can hear her, but he's still driving away, leaving her for what he thinks is her own good.
Autumn takes a deep breath and shouts as loud as she can...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: For the ride back, at least... I owe you for that...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No. You don't owe me a thing. And you never will.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Everything I did for you, I did because it was my choice. Not because I wanted anything in return.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: For what?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: For the ride back, if nothing else.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: After all those hurtful things I said, you could've just made me walk back. You didn't have to give me a ride.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But you did. Because you're a good person. Because you care about me.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And if you care about me at all... You'll let me get out of your life before I bring you any more misery.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Legally? Naw. But it's amazing what a few bribes slipped into the right hands will get you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If you ask the state of California, they'll tell you I live with my kindly uncle Finnegan in a lovely three-bedroom house down in the suburbs.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So you do this on purpose? You `like` living alone?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you do this on purpose? You [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] living alone?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Like's a strong word. But it beats all the foster homes I've been in, I'll tell you that.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, I... I had no idea. It sounds like you've had such a rough life...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: My life is what it is, Autumn. Yeah, it could've been easier.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But you know what? I got through. I made it.  `Survived.` And here I am now.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you know what? I got through. I made it.  [color=#e23b3b][i]Survived.[/i][/color] And here I am now.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...A King Creeper who treats everyone in his life like a puppet, and just drove away the only person he ever really cared about.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, wait, I--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You said what you meant. It's the truth. I needed to hear it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And I'll survive. I always do.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I've done you enough harm today, Autumn. Let's just get this over with.
Autumn reaches out, but Wes turns away. He reaches under the desk, fusses around, and pulls out a car key.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You have another car?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's for an old, rusted truck that barely works. It was the only thing my uncle... My `real` uncle... Left to me when he died.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's for an old, rusted truck that barely works. It was the only thing my uncle... My [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] uncle... Left to me when he died.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I wish I could just let you drive it, but the thing's so busted you gotta have a golden touch. So looks like I've gotta give you a ride.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Just let me do you this one last favor... This one last try at setting things right... And then I'll be out of your life forever.
Wes tosses the key up and catches it in his other hand.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Come on. If we even want a shot at exposing Lindsay... We've got to move fast.
Twenty minutes later, Wes and Autumn pull up outside Twin Branches High. They'd driven the whole way in tense, awkward silence.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We're here. You gotta get in that gym and talk to Nikolai, `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: We're here. You gotta get in that gym and talk to Nikolai, [color=#e23b3b][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Will you be here when I come back?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...No. I won't. And that's for the best.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You were right, Autumn. You don't need someone like me in your life. I'm nothing but trouble, and all I'll do is bring you down.
Wes nudges his head towards the gym door.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Your mom, your dad... I don't see anything about them. Where are they, Wes?
Wes turns to Autumn, and his face darkens, hardening into an icy scowl.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...They're gone.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But, I meant...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I know what you meant, Autumn. And I know there's a lot about myself I keep hidden, a lot I should learn to share...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But don't ever, `ever` ask about my parents.
nodes.text_bbcode: But don't ever, [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] ask about my parents.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: O... Okay. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I just... I'm just trying to understand what's going on here. You live out here by yourself? All alone? Is that even allowed?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: My things?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know, your possessions, your belongings, your `stuff.` Where's all your stuff?
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, your possessions, your belongings, your [color=#3b78e2][i]stuff.[/i][/color] Where's all your stuff?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You're looking at it.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But... I know you've got money. You charge people all the time. What you do with it?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I save it for when I'll need it. When I want to, I don't know, go to college or start a business.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's... Actually very responsible.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But... I mean, are you okay with that? Don't you `want` things?
nodes.text_bbcode: But... I mean, are you okay with that? Don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] things?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Possessions break. Objects burn. I've learned not to get attached to anything that could go away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That, and I figure... Don't own anything that'll weigh you down if you need to run.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can understand that, I guess... But do you really live out here by yourself? All alone? Is that even allowed?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, wait...
Despite herself, Autumn hesitates going after him. She's never been somewhere like this, and there's a part of her that recoils, in fear, in distrust...
But she forces herself forward, into the trailer, after Wes.
The inside of the trailer is completely sparse: besides a mattress, a mini-fridge, and an old laptop, there's barely anything else.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Welcome to my humble abode, Autumn.
Autumn looks around, stunned. There's no pictures, no mementos, no trophies or personal items. There's nothing.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes, I... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And, what, exactly, don't you understand?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, for starters, where are your...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You live here, don't you? That's why you never talk about it... Why you've never mentioned your home, not once...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yeah, well, do you blame me? It's not exactly a palace. Or a mansion. Or even, you know, a house.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: It's a dump, Autumn. But it's `my` dump.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a dump, Autumn. But it's [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] dump.

nodes.text: Wes steps through the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...My hideout?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know. Your secret lair. Your base of operations. The place where you go to... To do all your schemes.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Is that what you think this is?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: More than you can know.
Wes turns to the trailer, sighing deeply.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If this was my hideout, I might actually be proud of it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No, Autumn... This is my home.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh... I... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Don't be. It is what it is. At least now you know why I never invited anyone over.
Wes steps through the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Autumn, please...
Wes reaches out for Autumn, but she shoves his hand away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. Don't touch me. Don't you ever touch me.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Everything I did... I did for you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But that's just the thing, Wes. I didn't `ask` you to do any of it. I didn't `want` any of this.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that's just the thing, Wes. I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]ask[/i][/color] you to do any of it. I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] any of this.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You must think you're so clever, knowing all my secrets, setting up this elaborate, tricky con...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But did you ever think to just give me a call? To ask how I was doing? To see if I wanted to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...That's not how I do things.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: No. It's not. You'd prefer to just go through life like some King Creeper, manipulating everyone, treating them like your little puppets.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Is everyone just a toy for you to play with? Just another pawn for you to exploit? Is that how you see us?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Not you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Never you.
Autumn shakes her head and turns away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Just leave me out of this from now on, Wes. I don't need someone like you in my life stirring up trouble.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Don't call me again.
Autumn starts to stalk off. Wes watches her go, a look of quiet but complete devastation on his face...
Then he shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Wait. Seriously. If nothing else...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: At least let me get you a ride back to school.
Wes turns to the side, shoving his way through some bushes, and vanishes.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Wes?
Autumn sighs deeply, and strides through the bushes after him...
Emerging in a woodland grove, hidden from sight, with an old run-down trailer sitting in the middle of it.

The sides of it are worn and faded, all peeling paint and rusted metal. The wheels are long deflated, and an old generator wheezes alongside it. Cinderblocks, tires, and other trash litter the ground.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What... What the...
Wes strides towards it, hopping over an abandoned tire and a broken bike, and unlocks the front door.
An old bulldog, blind in one eye, pops its head out. Wes scratches him behind the ears.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey there, old buddy. How's it going, huh? How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What is this place, Wes?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: The one place I never, ever wanted you to see.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Oh my gosh. Wes, is this... Is this...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You wanted to test me! To teach me to stand up for myself! So you set up this whole thing with Lindsay as a way for me to prove myself!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No... `No.` That's not true at all. I would never set something like this up. I would never hurt you.
nodes.text_bbcode: No... [color=#e23b3b][i]No.[/i][/color] That's not true at all. I would never set something like this up. I would never hurt you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Everything I did... I did because I wanted for you to be happy. For you to have the chance you deserve. I wanted you to `win...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Everything I did... I did because I wanted for you to be happy. For you to have the chance you deserve. I wanted you to [color=#e23b3b][i]win...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...The internship. The tryouts. The other contestants dropping out.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You set all that up?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...I did.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I can't believe it. I can't believe `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe it. I can't believe [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I... I don't know what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yes, you do! Don't lie to me, Wes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's all just too perfect, isn't it? My favorite photographer holding tryouts to be his intern at my old high school...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: $ZOE calling me up... Nick being out of town... Andrew dropping out...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You're behind everything, aren't you?
Wes struggles for words, then sighs deeply.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Yes. Yes, I am.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I should've known. I can't believe I was so stupid, so trusting. `Of course` nothing good could just happen to me...
nodes.text_bbcode: I should've known. I can't believe I was so stupid, so trusting. [color=#3b78e2][i]Of course[/i][/color] nothing good could just happen to me...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Of course you were behind it all.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Ow...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, it's okay. My ankle just hurts from falling back there, that's all.
Twenty minutes later, Autumn and Wes walk along a winding road leading back into town...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Just a little further. I know a place... Well, it's a place we can get some help.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: If we get lucky, we can still get you to back to the school in time.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I appreciate the optimism, Wes, but... I really think it'd be better for me to start just accepting the inevitable.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I mean, come on, Wes. It's over. Lindsay won. She... She always wins.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: We tried our best, but she always had the upper hand, and there's nothing we can do about it. It's better to just accept what we have and be happy with it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No. You never accept losing. You never let someone like Lindsay get away with cheating.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: No matter what, you never let the world grind you down. You never let it beat you.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Maybe I'm just not as strong as you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But you are, Autumn. You just gotta realize it.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You can stand up for yourself. You can stand up to Lindsay. You can stand up to that cheerleader at your new school, the one that's always giving you such a hard time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You can--

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...Wait.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How did you know about the cheerleader at my new school?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm? Oh, you mentioned her to me this morning.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: ...No, I didn't. I just told you I was having a bad time.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure you mentioned her...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `No.` I didn't. The only time I ever talked about her was on my video diary, ArtOfStone...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]No.[/i][/color] I didn't. The only time I ever talked about her was on my video diary, ArtOfStone...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Did you... Did you watch it?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You did! But how? That's only meant for the photography forum I post on! No one in real life is supposed to see that!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How did you even know about it?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I... You know... Keep tabs on people online. I like to know what people are up to. It's not a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It `is` a big deal. You stalked me online! You violated my privacy!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a big deal. You stalked me online! You violated my privacy!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, yes, I did, and I'm sorry. I just... I can't stand to see you unhappy.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You can't stand to...
Autumn's eyes go wide with realization.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You... You set this all up!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I'm taking about...

nodes.title: The Conned Artist, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Can Autumn and Wes prove Lindsay cheated?

nodes.text: Previously, on `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Previously, on [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: Autumn was invited back to Twin Branches High School to participate in tryouts for a dream internship with a famous photographer...
But even though she did a great job, Lindsay somehow showed up with an amazing portfolio of gorgeous nature shots!
Unbeknownst to Autumn, Wes set the tryouts up, and even rigged Lindsay's camera to break... Which means that she must have cheated!
And now...
You are now Autumn.
While Nikolai Tyrell judges the submitted photos to decide on an intern, Autumn sits alone in the empty school cafeteria...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Why did it have to be Lindsay, of all people?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Anyone else, and I'd understand. It was a fair contest, and she did a good job.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: But after everything Lindsay did to me... Trashing my show and breaking my mom's camera... If she takes this from me too...
Autumn sighs and looks around the room.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I swear, sometimes I feel like my life is cursed. First that cheerleader at my new school spills coffee all over me, and then--

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey there.
Autumn spins around to find Wes standing behind her.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hiding out?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess so. I just needed to be alone, at least for a little while.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. I hide out all the time. Way better than being seen.
Wes walks over and takes a seat next to Autumn.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: I don't suppose Nikolai's made his decision yet...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Nope. Still thinking. And I don't think he's going to make a decision any time soon.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Well, he's got a lot to think about. Lindsay's photo set was `really` good!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, he's got a lot to think about. Lindsay's photo set was [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] good!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Yours was better.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: It's sweet of you to say that, but what really matters is what Nikolai thinks.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What if he picks Lindsay? I can't handle...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Hmmm... Like a frog...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What about that one over there? That's kind of froggish...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: That's it! Good eye!
Wes and Autumn rush over to the rock, descending into a beautiful forest clearing...
Where a middle-aged man is busily snapping nature photos!

nodes.speaker: Photographer
nodes.text: Oh yeah... That's perfect... The way the light falls on the leaves, mmm! `Mmm!` Just wonderful!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah... That's perfect... The way the light falls on the leaves, mmm! [color=#e23b3b][i]Mmm![/i][/color] Just wonderful!

nodes.text: Autumn and Wes huddle up, hidden behind some bushes. They talk in urgent whispers...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: What do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well, we need to find out if he helped Lindsay, right? But if we ask him directly, he might deny it...

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Right! So let's do one of your famous cons!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: My what?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know! Your plots or schemes or double dupes!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, I have `never` done a double dupe...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I have [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] done a double dupe...

nodes.text: Autumn playfully punches Wes in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: You know what I mean, jerk!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, okay, we'll do a con. What'd you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Hmmm... Let's pretend to be...
Autumn looks around frantically and sees Wes in his truck, pulling away.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: Wes!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: `Wes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wes![/i][/color]

nodes.text: He shakes his head. He can hear her, but he's still driving away, leaving her for what he thinks is her own good.
Autumn takes a deep breath and shouts as loud as she can...
Wes pulls over into a small parking lot in front of an old sign saying 'Georgette Woods'.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: So what now?
Wes hops a railing and sets off, tromping into the woods.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We go right to the source.

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: How do we know where to go?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Just keep your eyes open! Look for anything from the photos. And stay close... No cell service out here.
Autumn looks around, and makes her way towards...
She has failed.

The next day, Wes stands in the middle of a suburban road, whistling to himself...
When a bright red sports car rounds the corner!
The car drives down the street and stops right in front of Wes. The driver's door swings open, and Lindsay steps out.
You! What are you doing here, weirdo? Casing the neighborhood so you can see which houses to rob?
Not a bad idea... But I'm actually here to talk to you.
Oh, what, you want to gloat? Yeah, yeah, you and your little Art Dork managed to snatch that internship from me. Big deal.
Actually, I've got to give you credit, Lindsay. I underestimated you. You came so close to having me beat... Closer than anyone I've ever had to deal with before.
You're crafty and cunning and seem to possess no moral compass whatsoever. You're one heck of an enemy.
Crossing me was the biggest mistake of your life... And I'm guessing you've made a lot of mistakes.
I hope you didn't have any plans on enjoying high school... Because from now on, I am dedicating the rest of my life to ruining the rest of yours.
You know what? I believe it. Because if I'm on your crap list already, I hate to see what you're going to do next.
Wes steps forward towards Lindsay's car, pulling a baseball bat out from behind his back.
What... What is that? What are you doing?
Scheming against me? I can handle it. Deflating my tires? Messed up, but still, fair game.
But everything you did to Autumn... Trashing her art show... Smashing her mother's camera...
Well, let's just say she deserves a little payback.
Startled, Lindsay backs away. Wes strides up to her car, winds up with his bat, and...
Wes brings the bat down right into the windshield! It explodes in a spray of shards!
Wes slams the bat down on the mirror, snapping it off and sending it flying!
Wes spins around to the other side of the car...
Wes jams the bat clean through the driver's window!
You can't do this! This is an outrage! No one does this to me!
Still grinning, Wes strides back to the front of the car...
In front of Wes, Lindsay's brand new car is a shattered ruin, a mess of dented metal and broken glass.
Wes tosses the bat aside, satisfied.
Oh wait! I almost forgot! There's one more thing I owe you!
Wes spins around and tosses a stink bomb at Lindsay's feet! It explodes, spraying her in a brown cloud that reeks of fish vomit!
Agggggh! You total psycho! You've always been shady, but you have gone way too far this time!
Do you really think you'll get away with this? My dad'll tell Principal McCormick all about it! She'll have you expelled!
Wes walks away, but as he does, he smiles a little...
Expelled? So I'll have to transfer to another school?
